about: SCION 32 trace, measured from the render. x_screen/y_screen: centroid of the dog's visible pixels in an id pass of the same frame (same camera and depth test). x_world_measured: that centroid back-projected through the frame's camera onto the vertical plane of the dog's line, plus the mapping offset (metres, score units). facing: +1 when the muzzle (rig nose and skull points projected with the frame camera) points toward the door on screen, -1 away. state: from the measured onsets below, not from the score's labels. x_score: the rig's body-middle position mapped back to score metres. posture: reported by the rig (lie, crouch, moving).
camera: one wide set-up 0-14.6 s, then a moving camera (tracking the approach, settling behind the dog's right shoulder at the sill); x_world_measured is therefore given every frame

onsets_measured.measure: dog silhouette centroid, back-projected to the path, moves > 2 cm away from the door (from its 0.5-0.9 s mean)
top of the visible head rises > 2 cm above its lowest point of the retreat (1.5-2.2 s)
muzzle direction on screen turns > 10 deg from its 3.3 s heading (the head leads the turn away)
angle between the muzzle and the door on screen falls > 10 deg from its 7.3 s value (the head comes round)
silhouette centroid, back-projected, moves > 2 cm toward the door (from its 14.0-14.5 s mean)
top of the visible silhouette, in metres over the floor at the dog, drops > 2 cm (from its 23.3-23.6 s mean)
centroid of the visible head moves > 4 px (from its 25.9-26.3 s mean) as it lifts level and turns into the doorway
